resisted: Nothing resisted coverage. 2065 reads out to both output and gate 707; handled with identity node identity_707 on 2065->707 rather than a split, root composes the two leaves serially. 6 unconnected inputs (restecg:0, restecg:2, exang:0, slope:3, thal:4, thal:7) listed as root entries only to reach structural coverage 1.0. thal:6 correction rests on 10 training patients; may be partly noise-fitted.
tool_bugs: compute_shap mean |SHAP| = 0 for cp:2 despite logit effect -0.113 via 3497. compute_shap >2 min. get_formula shows output as ReLU.
summary: Essentially logistic regression: 17 direct edges (logit SD 4.44; ca +2.16, slope:2 +1.08, sex:1 +0.85). One meaningful nonlinearity: discrete gate 2065 = ReLU(0.795 thal:6 - 0.885 fbs:1 - 0.719), firing only for fixed-defect patients with normal fasting sugar and lowering their logit by ~3.6, cancelling the linear core's over-calling in that group. cp:2 indicator (3497) and floored thalach relay (707->3677) near-inert. Train AUC 0.942 vs 0.934 linear core.
